summary: A very well presented bright and spacious one double bedroom flat on 23rd floor of the building in Angel
feesApplyText:
FEE SCHEDULE: ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCIES

In addition to paying rent, you may also be required to make the following permitted payments:

Holding Deposit (per tenancy): one week's rent. Please note that this will be withheld if any relevant person (including any guarantor(s)) withdraws from the tenancy, fails a Right-to-Rent check, provides materially significant false or misleading information, or fails to sign their tenancy agreement (and/or Deed of Guarantee) within 15 calendar days (or other Deadline for Agreement as mutually agreed in writing).

Security Deposit per tenancy. Rent under £50,000 per year: five weeks' rent. Rent £50,000 or over per year: six weeks' rent.

Interest payments for late payment of rent: 3% above the Bank of England Base Rate from rent due date until paid.

Lost Key(s) or other Security Device(s): Tenants are liable for the actual cost of replacing any lost key(s) or other security device(s). If the loss results in locks needing to be changed, the costs of a locksmith, new lock and replacement keys for any persons requiring keys will be charged to the tenant, along with any extra costs incurred.

Variation of Contract (Tenant's Request): £50.00 (inc. VAT) per agreed variation or any reasonable costs incurred if higher. 

Change of Sharer (Tenant's Request): £50.00 (inc. VAT) per replacement tenant or any reasonable costs incurred if higher.

Early Termination (Tenant's Request): should the tenant wish to leave their contract early, they shall be liable for the landlord's costs in re-letting the property as well as all rent due under the tenancy until the start date of the replacement tenancy. These costs will be no more than the maximum amount of rent outstanding on the tenancy

FEE SCHEDULE: NON- ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCIES

In addition to paying rent, you may also be required to make the following permitted payments:

Holding Deposit (per tenancy): one week's rent. Please note that this will be withheld if any relevant person (including any guarantor(s)) withdraws from the tenancy, fails a Right-to-Rent check, provides materially significant false or misleading information, or fails to sign their tenancy agreement (and/or Deed of Guarantee) within 15 calendar days (or other Deadline for Agreement as mutually agreed in writing).

Tenancy Agreement Fee: £240.00 (inc. VAT) per tenant. Processing the application, associated paperwork, contract negotiation (amending and agreeing terms) and arranging the tenancy and agreement.

Inventory Check-in or Check-out Fee: price may vary from £78.00 - £189.00 (inc. VAT) for Redac Strattons to instruct our sub-contractor. The cost of check in or check out depends on the size of the property and the inventory company s charges. Please ask your contact at Redac Strattons  for the price list.

Change of Occupier Fee £360.00 (inc. VAT). Contract negotiation, amending terms and updating your tenancy agreement during your tenancy subject to the Landlord s approval.

Renewal Contract Fee (tenant's share) £120.00 (inc. VAT). Contract negotiation, amending and updating terms and arranging a further tenancy and agreement.

End of Tenancy Cleaning: guide price available upon request. You can organise professional cleaning or instruct Redac Strattons. If you instruct Redac Strattons, this fee may be deducted from the Security Deposit by agreement prior to the arrangement. The price differs depending on the size of the property. Please ask our Tenancy Termination Department for a guide price list for this service.


Redac Strattons is a member of CMP, which is a client money protection scheme, and a member of PRS, which is a redress scheme.
